rationale.hitl-workflow: Human operators approve phase gates, arbitrate trade-offs, and block scope changes.
rationale.ai-review: Specialized adversarial AI lenses independently judge designs and implementation drift.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Compile, lint, tests, and scope inventories provide grounded exit checks.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Coverage matrices expose finding severity and concentration for human judgment.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Spec-drift micro-checks and scope inventories detect departures from approved intent.
rationale.automation-bias: Treats experienced developers’ fluency-driven misjudgment as a residual oversight limit.
rationale.oversight-theater: Identifies affirmative AI self-validation as review without meaningful epistemic force.
rationale.quality-debt: Frames AI acceleration as multiplying complexity, coupling, and technical debt.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent specs preserve decisions and rationale across sessions and versions.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: A universal regulatory lens traces external requirements into reviewed system modules.
rationale.metrics: Defines comprehensibility and quality scores used as phase-exit conditions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes tool-centric capability fixes and unstructured automation-maximalist development.
